text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everything that happens from now on is
real.
That's why I have to make sure to
witness it with
my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll create striking memories for
myself—for
everyone! And I'll make each
and every moment
shine brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion doesn't finish her sentence,
but it's
enough. I understand exactly
what she's feeling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day it was decided she would run in
the
Twinkle Series, Fine Motion's eyes
sparkled
brightly, and her excitement
for the future
swelled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she heads towards her glorious finale,
she
looks more beautiful than I can ever
remember
seeing her.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's really Fine Motion! I would've
thought
she'd choose the Arima or
something like that!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how the race is gonna turn out.
I'm
starting to get excited here!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, hold on just a minute! Fine's not
the only
big star here!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fine! I heard you're going back home
soon.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right. That's why, I—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then, there's no doubt about it! Today's
the day I
mercilessly pound you into a
fine dust!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's only proper for a princess to clash
with her
rival head-on and give it all
she's got!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right, please come at me with full force.

However...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Know that I'm going to send you flying
and take
victory for myself! ♪
